Nothing was archived when you approved, and Gmail is unchanged. A second approval gate is waiting for you, and kx.5 and kx stay open until it runs.

**Why nothing was archived:** between my preview and your approval, you edited `sase.md` on the Mac. The edit moved the "Try Fable 5.2!" task from line 592 to 595. That task links one of the 9 threads, and the code bob uses to confirm an archive (the "digest") includes task line numbers. So when the line moved, bob refused every write. That's the safety check doing its job, not a bug.

**What did change:** archiving is now on for the Mac. The run applied the config, recorded the starting state bob needs, and added an "Archived by Bob" view to `mail.base`. I also applied the same chezmoi update on this machine, which is safe because the Gmail sync cron only runs on the Mac.

**Hourly cron:** until you approve, each :07 run on the Mac stops at the confirmation step and exits 1, so cron will email you a failure each hour. The 10:07 run already did this; it changed nothing in Gmail.

**The new gate:** "Retry: archive 4 Gmail threads…". I reran the preview at 10:03, and it lists the same 4 threads to archive and the same 5 to keep, with the same messages. If you approve, it runs on the Mac:
1. It reruns that preview.
2. It continues only if every thread, message, decision, and linked task still matches what you approved, ignoring line numbers. Otherwise it archives nothing and lists what changed.
3. It runs the archive confirmed with that fresh preview, so bob still blocks the write if anything changes in the seconds between steps 1 and 3.

I ran its preview check (the `p` key) against the Mac, and it reports the set unchanged. Rejecting turns archiving back off.

Once it runs, a follow-up agent will:
- check in Gmail and in each mail note that the 4 threads were archived;
- test undo and moving a thread back to the Inbox on one of them, asking you for the parts only you can do;
- check the next :07 cron run;
- close kx.5 and kx.

**Bead notes:** the cause and what was written on the Mac are on kx.5. I also left a note on kx about the line-number problem, since edits to task files will keep breaking confirmations. It asks for a separate task to be filed before kx closes so the issue isn't lost.
